description: Bulk modulus B0 from DFT E-V curve fitting

_version_legend.v1: Original Pipeline v1 — ordered-Li 0K structures, DFT BM-EOS over 8-11 volume points
_version_legend.v2: Annealed Li (champion config from MLIP 500K Langevin) → DFT BM-EOS at the deeper basin
_version_legend.v3: Pipeline v2 §8d: stress-strain finite-strain Cij (no separate BM-EOS run); K = B_VRH derived from 12 strain SCFs. Cross-validated against v1/v2 BM K.

_normalization_warning: B0 / B0' / R² are intensive — direct cross-system comparison is OK. V0_A3 is EXTENSIVE (scales with supercell size). Li6 family (comp1, comp2) uses 4 fu = 52 atoms cubic; Li5.4 family (comp3, comp4, comp5, modelc, modelc_v3) uses 5 fu = 62 atoms rhombohedral. To compare V0 across systems, ALWAYS normalize: V/atom = V0/atoms or V/fu = V0/formula_units (atoms + formula_units recorded in db/compositions/*.json). Example: raw V0(LPSCl)=1016.62 vs V0(LPSCl1.6)=1216.44 looks like +20% expansion but is actually +0.4% V/atom (framework preserved) and −4.3% V/fu (vacancy + Cl→S substitution → fu shrinks, matches experiment).

results.notes: Annealing Li. Delta vs v1: +0.3 GPa
ordered Li 0K. Basin B found: 16.6 meV more stable but EOS unstable. Superseded by modelc_v3 for paper values.
Annealing champion -258.2051 eV. Delta vs v1 DFT: -1.7 GPa. DFT BM-EOS pending (v2). DFT stress-strain K available (v3).

Nd2O3-doped modelc (Li48P10Nd2S41O3Cl16, 120 atoms, x=0.20, Track1 Nd->Li). UMA-omat EOS ensemble, 100 members, source pair_00_reference (= run5 v0_champion). HEADLINE B0=18.9+/-1.4 GPa over the 72 members with physical B0'>0; full 100-member 18.6+/-3.0. B0' poorly constrained / MULTIMODAL: dominant cluster B0'~11 @ B0 18.4; physical-B0' cluster (~6) @ B0 ~20; garbage B0'<0 cluster @ B0 16.8. Classic few-point BM B0-B0' covariance. f-electron (Nd) -> UMA reliability LOW, absolute value DIRECTIONAL ONLY. DFT EOS pending (KISTI 3_dft_eos_v7; run5 = V0 point, E=-3566.2095 Ry, geometry converged force<5e-3). Same-method vs undoped modelc UMA 20.0 -> ~-1.1 GPa softening (Nd3+ size, +2.6% V/atom).

results._warning: Different B0 (19.59 vs primary 21.71) and B0' (2.92 free vs primary 7.01) come from fitter / B0' constraint choice, not different data. Both R²≈0.999. Free fit has large B0-B0' covariance — see fit_plot_png for visualization.
results.stress_strain_aside_note: K_VRH from clamped-ion stress-strain Cij is a DIFFERENT physical quantity from BM-EOS B0; reported in db/properties/elastic.json dft_0K_clamped_ion_stress_strain_full_Cij section.

trends.Li6_family: comp1(26.2) > comp2(25.8) -> Br up, B0 down
trends.cross_family: Li6(~26) > Li5.4(~21) -> vacancy + S reduction -> B0 down by ~5 GPa
trends.Br_effect: Br increase -> B0 decrease (⚠ Li6 계열에서만 성립. Li5.4 계열은 Br 3->4->5 에서 20.8->20.8->22.9 로 마지막 구간이 증가한다 — 2026-07-29 정정)

modelc_nd_doped.note: x=0.20 Nd->Li. f-electron, UMA LOW-confidence (multimodal B0', absolute value uncertain ~18.4-20). DFT EOS in progress 3_dft_eos_v7, run5=V0.

v1_vs_v2_comparison.interpretation: Li6: v1≈v2 (0.3 GPa, annealing optional). Li5.4: v1≠v2 (1.7 GPa, annealing essential). Flat Li landscape + hidden deep basin = 0K methods fail for Li5.4.
v1_vs_v2_comparison.implication: comp3/4/5 (Li5.4+Br) should be recalculated with v2 pipeline

physics.vacancy_effect: Compositional vacancy reduces bond density -> B0 down ~5.4 GPa
physics.Li_ordering_effect: Same composition, different Li arrangement: comp5 DB0=1.3 GPa (basin A vs B), Model C DB0=1.7 GPa (v1 vs v2 annealing)
